title: PinPin steps down — corrected Beaver and chair
beat: After supervised steering, PinPin descends to rejoin Mama and PomPom before everyone walks back to picnic.
camera: Same side as boarding, slightly wider to show Beaver on grass; hood left.
staging: Exactly four animals; PinPin on exterior steps, Beaver on grass assisting, Mama and baby waiting.
alt: PinPin steps down from the parked tractor with Beaver helping from the ground while Mama and PomPom wait.

references.role: Edit target; preserve successful step geometry and descending action.
Beaver species identity only: fur, muzzle, teeth, flat scaled paddle tail.
Original single visible lower operator chair at image right inside cab; remove extra foreground chair added later.

prompt: Precise correction to image 1, landscape1536x1024. Change ONLY these two errors: (1) The blue-vest animal helping PinPin is BEAVER. Restore his actual beaver identity from image 2: smooth soft chestnut fur on head/back, round ears, broad muzzle, two characteristic front teeth, ONE broad flat dark scaly paddle tail on grass. He must have NO hedgehog quills and NO furry tail. Keep his current body position/size, vest, helping-paw contact, other relaxed paw and feet unchanged. (2) Remove the EXTRA tall upholstered chair on imageLEFT inside cab (the one immediately behind steering column). Restore open dark footwell/dashboard clearance in that space. Keep the ORIGINAL lower gray operator chair on imageRIGHT inside cab unchanged, as in image3; it faces forward toward hood LEFT with steering ahead. Image3 is original chair/cab reference only. Preserve all other image1 content exactly: PinPin's face, limbs, downward pose and paw contacts; Mama and tiny PomPom; the EXISTING stair geometry and heights, red sill, floor, parked machine, wheels, empty tandem trailer, crane, bridge, forest and sunlight. No other changes, no extra characters or limbs, no text.
review: Unpublished proposal ready for independent/user review. Four cast members visible: PinPin descends outward with one hind paw on a lower tread and the other on upper threshold, one forepaw supported by Beaver and other touching entry edge. Beaver stands on grass, now correctly rendered with smooth chestnut fur, two front teeth and a single flat scaled paddle tail; no quills. Mama and tiny PomPom remain waiting. The extra tall foreground chair is removed; original lower operator chair remains, with steering ahead toward hood left. External tread/sill positions now align with boarding reference; trailer remains empty with two near-side wheels and crane directly behind cab. No confirmed duplicated visible limb attachments. Caveat: PinPin's descending hind leg is noticeably extended; stylized posture and hidden attachments are not anatomical proof. Cabin reveals a few control levers in previously occupied space, so this is not pixel-identical preservation. Approval pending; no publication.
